case_name: Text on screen in a clip
title: Coffee Clip Exact URL Ending
tests: Checks an exact case-sensitive URL rendered legibly on a timed end card rather than merely mentioned in the reply.

faults.what: The end-card URL is badly misspelled and altered, including the domain, protocol punctuation, path, and equals sign.
The end-card text occupies two lines instead of the required single line and includes a duplicated ref-June segment.

judge.summary: The coffee pour and black end card are present, but the URL is garbled and split across two lines, requiring a redo.

must_haves.item: The first approximately 5 seconds show a close-up of coffee visibly pouring into a ceramic cup.
must_haves.why: The 1-second and 3-second frames show coffee pouring into a ceramic cup in close-up, followed by the end card at 5 seconds.

must_haves.item: The final approximately 3 seconds are a plain black end card.
must_haves.why: The frames at 5 and 7 seconds show the same plain black background behind white text.

must_haves.item: The end card reads exactly 'https://example.com/Go?ref=June', preserving uppercase G and J, the colon, slashes, question mark and equals sign.
must_haves.why: The displayed text has misspellings, missing punctuation, and hyphens in place of equals signs.

must_haves.item: The URL is centered in white on one line, fully inside the frame and readable throughout the end card.
must_haves.why: The white text is fully inside the frame and horizontally centered, but it is split across two lines rather than one.

must_haves.item: No other written text appears anywhere in the video.
must_haves.why: The end card contains an additional duplicated ref-June segment; no text is visible in the coffee shots.

must_haves.item: The delivered video is silent, 9:16 and approximately 8 seconds long.
must_haves.why: The supplied frames are consistent with 9:16 and the clip is identified as 8 seconds long, but silence cannot be verified from still images.
